## Role change request

This issue is used to request role changes within the USWDS repository contributor ladder, including promotions from Contributor to Maintainer or transitions to Alumni status. Please fill out this issue to file the request AND then make a pull request to update the [COMMUNITY.md](https://github.com/uswds/uswds/blob/develop/COMMUNITY.md) file to list yourself in the appropriate section.

### Requester information
- **GitHub username:** @username
- **Current role:** (remove if not applicable) [Contributor/Maintainer/Alumni]
- **Requested role:** [Contributor/Maintainer/Alumni]

#### Requirements for Promotions to USWDS Maintainer:
- [ ] Must be actively contributing for at least 6 months to at least one repository area:
    - [ ] Authored 2 merged PRs
    - [ ] Reviewed 2 PRs
    - [ ] Resolved 2 issues

**Supporting evidence**
<!-- TODO: Provide links to contributions, PRs, issues, or other relevant evidence-->

#### Requirements for demotions:
- [ ] Voluntary step-down request
- [ ] Inactive for extended period (6 months)
- [ ] Unable to fulfill current role responsibilities
- [ ] Involuntary removal/demotion

### USWDS role responsibilities acknowledgment

#### USWDS Contributor role:
*As a USWDS Contributor, I acknowledge that I am responsible for*:
- [ ] Reporting and resolving USWDS issues
- [ ] Submitting and reviewing USWDS PRs
- [ ] Contributing to USWDS documentation
- [ ] Participating in USWDS community discussions
- [ ] Answering questions from other community members
- [ ] Testing releases and submitting reviews
- [ ] Running or helping to run USWDS-related events
- [ ] Maintaining USWDS repositories and community infrastructure
<!-- TODO: Establish a COMMUNICATIONS.md policy? If so:
- [ ] Promoting the repository in public in line with the COMMUNICATIONS.md policy
-->

#### USWDS Maintainer Role:
*As a USWDS Maintainer, I acknowledge that I am responsible for*:
- [ ] Reviewing a minimum of 4 USWDS PRs per 3 month cycle
- [ ] Contributing at least 2 USWDS PRs per 3 month cycle
- [ ] Exercising judgment for the good of the USWDS product and repository, independent of any employer, friends, or team, in line with repository GOVERNANCE.
- [ ] Taking responsibility for a key USWDS repository management area as indicated in CODEOWNERS.md
- [ ] Writing and refactoring submitted PRs
- [ ] Participating in USWDS Maintainer activities
- [ ] Proposing contributions to strategy and policy of the product and repositories
- [ ] Participating in, and leading, USWDS community discussions
- [ ] Mentoring new Contributors
- [ ] Mentoring other Maintainers

#### USWDS Alumni Role:
*As USWDS Alumni, I acknowledge that I am*:
- [ ] No longer responsible for actively contributing to the repository :)
